# Third-party notice

This directory vendors code from [interviewstreet/hiring-agent](https://github.com/interviewstreet/hiring-agent)
("hiring-agent"), created by HackerRank — an AI agent that extracts structured
data from a resume PDF, enriches it with GitHub signals, and produces an
explainable candidate evaluation.

It is **not original work by this project's author**. It is used here,
unmodified in most files (see git history for any local changes), as the
resume-parsing and evaluation engine behind CV upload. It is included under
its original MIT license — see `LICENSE` in this directory.
